"""A use case that calls the FlowRepository port's get_draft method -- port_methods_without_use_case
must not report FlowRepository.get_draft as unused. Also the own-family import target for
tool_module_imports_own_family_only's compliant case."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


class GetDraftUseCase:
    """execute() reaches the port through an attribute access, which is all the scan looks for."""

    def __init__(self, flow_repo: Any) -> None:
        self._flow_repo = flow_repo

    def execute(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Compliant use: references .get_draft as an attribute node."""
        return self._flow_repo.get_draft(flow_id)
